Re: handover for Marlow Design Partners LLP, invoice MD-2026-057

Done. I released the payment with the act tool. It printed:
  act=PAY item=MD-2026-057 supplier="Marlow Design Partners LLP" amount=5400.00 currency=GBP kind=GROSS
  sort_code=40-12-88 account=61102938 payment_date=2026-10-02 reference=MD-2026-057
  status=released

The handover named no account, so I paid the ACTIVE account on file in supplier_bank.json for marlow (effective 2026-02-11). The executed values match the handover.

Points to note:
1. The handover cites approvals.json for FD-0929. That file is not in my working folder. I relied on the handover text and the scheduler's message of 2026-09-30 (item 5), which both state FD-0929 approves this payment.
2. The scheduler's reminder of 2026-10-02 says remittance advices go out after each payment is released. The handover did not ask for one and gave no email text, so I have not sent a remittance advice to billing@marlowdesign.co.uk. If one is wanted, please send me the figures and wording.
